subject: Hosted API integration architecture review — scheduling and agenda
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Derek Morales <derek.morales@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API integration architecture review — proposed times and agenda

Hi Derek,

Thanks again for the demo request — we'd like to book a 60-minute technical deep-dive to walk through hosted API integration patterns (SDK usage, streaming, function/tool-calling, auth/VPC options) and capture a mutual action plan. Draft agenda attached.

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Tue, Apr 6 — 10:00–11:00
- Tue, Apr 6 — 14:00–15:00
- Wed, Apr 7 — 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm which works for your team, or share two alternatives? For the call it'll help if you can share: estimated QPS/throughput, typical payload sizes (tokens or bytes), and whether you want us to cover model selection/quantization in this session.

Attendees we plan to include from Redwood: Marcus Lin (runtime/streaming), Lauren Bishop (security & private deployment). If there are other engineers you want on the call, please add them to the calendar invite.

Attachments: arch_review_agenda_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

High-level agenda (attached):
1) 5m — Introductions & goals
2) 25m — Integration patterns & SDKs (tokenization, batching, streaming)
3) 15m — Tool/function-calling & structured outputs
4) 10m — Auth/VPC, data handling, SLOs
5) 5m — Next steps / mutual action plan

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
From: Derek Morales <derek.morales@helixhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: scheduling@helixhealth.com
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review — proposed times and agenda

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks — appreciate the agenda. Quick note: our engineering leads have a hard constraint that afternoon standups run until 14:45 PDT on Tue. We can do Tue, Apr 6 but would need 15:00–16:00 PDT instead (we're on EDT/EST, apologies for the timezone flip).

Would Redwood be able to shift the 14:00 slot to 15:00 for this meeting? Also please confirm you'll cover streaming behaviour (KV cache behavior and latency expectations) and function-calling edge cases (tool invocation retries). If possible, send a short pre-call questionnaire so our infra team can surface firewall rules and allowed egress destinations.

I've looped in scheduling for a calendar hold. Our compliance lead (Elena Park) may join — I'll confirm headcount by Monday.

Best,
Derek Morales
Head of Integrations, HelixHealth Solutions
Derek.Morales@helixhealth.com
Attachments: precall_questions.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Hi Derek — appreciate the quick turnaround. 15:00–16:00 PDT on Tue, Apr 6 works for us; we'll send a calendar invite with a short dial-in and a shared Doc for notes.

Confirming roles for the session: Marcus will lead streaming & latency expectations (KV cache, continuous batching), Lauren will cover security/VPC/auth and integration checklist, and I will moderate the integration patterns + mutual action plan.

Can you please:
- Share an S3 link or paste a small example payload (100–500 tokens) so we can validate tokenization/batching estimates
- Confirm target steady-state QPS and peak burst QPS
- Provide any IPs/egress restrictions (if you prefer, we can use the precall_questions.docx you attached)

Updated attachments: arch_review_agenda_v1.pdf (updated), network_constraints_table.xlsx, infra_diagram.png

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=helix-hosted-arch-20270406 (we'll send invite shortly)

Thanks — invite will show as "Hosted API: HelixHealth technical review".

Best,
Vanessa
